projects.name: SecuraLM
projects.short_summary: A hackathon team project for a cybersecurity-focused AI copilot intended to help SOC analysts investigate security questions with retrieved threat-intelligence context and reduce unsupported answers compared with a general-purpose LLM.
projects.problem_solved: Aims to help security operations analysts connect natural-language security questions with relevant MITRE ATT&CK techniques and CVE vulnerability information, with source-grounded context for analysis.
projects.contribution: Prior project work included ATT&CK data ingestion, a ChromaDB-based retrieval pipeline using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, BM25 retrieval and cross-encoder reranking, and NVD ingestion. The NVD ingestion stored 2,000 CVE records; subsequent work focused on retrieving ATT&CK techniques and CVE vulnerabilities together.
projects.status: in-progress (hackathon team project; current completion status not confirmed)
outcomes: NVD ingestion stored 2,000 CVE vulnerability records in the project database.
projects.notes: The intended use includes security-question analysis and context such as technique mappings and vulnerability details. Repository URL, final model choice, deployment status, evaluation metrics, and individual versus team-owned features have not been confirmed. Do not present this as a completed or production-deployed system.
